# firstboot_project (Resource)

A project groups servers, volumes and other resources for organisation and reporting. It is a label, not a boundary: a project does not isolate anything and does not affect billing.

Deleting a project does NOT delete what was in it. The resources are simply no longer grouped, which is why destroying a project is safe and why it is not a substitute for destroying the servers.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The project's name. Renaming is applied in place, not by replacement.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
